constructions.title: Combined-overflow volume from the national outfall layer

layers.combined_overflow.totals.Vand_(m3.is: Features of the combined-sewer overflow layer whose annual water volume field `Vand_(m3/ aar)` holds a number - a number, or a string that parses as one once spaces are dropped and a decimal comma read as a point. A zero counts; an empty or unparseable field does not.
The sum, in m3 per year, of the annual water volume over exactly the features counted in the .n beside it - not over every structure in the layer.

constructions.what: The annual overflow volume the national combined-sewer overflow layer reports, and over how many structures.
constructions.model: `scripts/fetch_spildevand.py` fetches the layer and, for each property, coerces the values to numbers with `numeric()`, skipping empty and unparseable ones, and keeps a count and a sum of those that parse.
assumptions: One feature is one overflow structure.

justified.text: The sum is taken only over features that hold a number, and the count of those is stored beside it, so a page can say how many structures a total covers.

gaps: The volumes are the figures the utilities report or model, as published in the layer; how each was produced is not in the layer.
Structures with no volume are left out of the sum, not estimated, so the sum understates the layer's total by whatever they discharge.
A zero volume counts as a reported value; whether a zero means no overflow or an unfilled field is not recorded.
void_if: the layer is refetched and the script is not rerun
constructions.licenses: How much annual overflow volume the national layer reports, and over how many of its structures.
constructions.not_licensed: The volume of structures that report none, or any event-level discharge.

confirmed.by: fork w1-ni (written against numeric() and the totals loop in scripts/fetch_spildevand.py, read 2026-09-11: count of parseable values and their sum, zeros included; not yet read by the project owner)

constructions.title: Rain-dependent discharge points in the national register layer

n_features.is: Features in the national register layer of rain-dependent discharge points, as fetched: every feature counted once, whatever its structure type.

constructions.what: How many rain-dependent discharge points the national register lists.
constructions.model: `scripts/nitrogen.py` reads the layer and counts its features.
assumptions: One feature is one discharge point.

justified.text: The count is the length of the layer's feature list, taken where the page reads the layer for its Køge Bugt tables.

gaps: Nothing checks whether one physical outlet appears as more than one feature.
The layer is the copy fetched into data/raw; the page build does not refetch it.
void_if: the layer is refetched and the page is not rebuilt
constructions.licenses: How many rain-dependent discharge points the national register lists.
constructions.not_licensed: How many discharge in a given year, how much, or which of them any typetal is applied to.
